audience: traders and analysts who follow prices and check balances on Coinbase

useCases.title: Check the price and 24-hour change
useCases.text: Read the latest price, 24-hour change and volume of one product. List the tradable products with their status.

useCases.title: Read price candles and the order book
useCases.text: Read OHLCV candles for a product in a time window given in Unix seconds. Read the public order book with its bids and asks.

useCases.title: Review balances and portfolios
useCases.text: List the account balances of the connected portfolio. Read the positions and total value of one portfolio in one currency.

useCases.title: Review past orders and fills
useCases.text: List historical orders by product, status, side or date. Read the fills of those orders, with price, size and fee.

useCases.title: Check key permissions and fee tier
useCases.text: Read what the connected key may do, such as view, trade or transfer. Read the fee tier, volume and fees of the transaction summary.
